name: s8-nyc-311
label: EXAMPLE · AI STAND-IN VOICE · NO FACE

lines.say: New Yorkers filed almost four million complaints with 311 in the last year.
lines.tts: New Yorkers filed almost four million complaints with three one one in the last year.

lines.say: I loaded every one of them into Microsoft Fabric and asked it questions in plain English.
lines.show: Every one, into *Microsoft Fabric*. Asked in *plain English*.

lines.say: Number one isn't noise. It's illegal parking. Six hundred and eleven thousand complaints.
lines.title: Top complaints

lines.say: Residential noise is second, and noise has a clock.
lines.show: Residential noise is *second*. And noise has *a clock*.

lines.say: Complaints about noisy neighbours peak between ten and eleven at night.
lines.title: THE PEAK HOUR

lines.say: And the worst day isn't Friday or Saturday. It's Sunday.
lines.title: Residential noise by day

lines.say: Over half of those are loud music or a party. Most of the rest are banging and pounding.
lines.title: What the noise is

lines.say: Heat is the seasonal one. January had about twenty-two times more heat complaints than August.
lines.title: Heat / hot water

lines.say: But my favourite part of this data set is the bottom of the list.
lines.show: My favourite part: *the bottom of the list*.

lines.say: Fifteen complaints about radioactive material. Six about squeegees. And exactly one complaint filed under trapping pigeon.
lines.title: The bottom of the list

lines.say: Comment NYC and I'll send you the data set and every question I asked.
lines.tts: Comment N Y C and I'll send you the data set and every question I asked.
